options.description: Vitest browser mode for component behaviour, Playwright for whole-app flows. Full coverage of both levels. Cost: two ways to write a browser test, and the agent must pick correctly every time.

options.description: A single number over all of src/, around 70%. Simple to state and to check. It counts a cheap line in fold.ts and an expensive line in agent.ts the same, so the agent will chase the cheap ones to hit the number.

questions.question: What does a risk tier actually remove?

options.label: Approval at gates (Recommended)
options.description: All three stages always run. A low-risk tier auto-passes G1 and G3 instead of waiting for you. This keeps #st-gates' contract intact — every gate still emits a log event, per #tk-gates. It also matches the card's own cited evidence, the 2026 auto-merge-for-low-risk pattern, which is about gating, not about skipping work.

options.label: Whole stages
options.description: A fix skips plan and validate entirely and runs build only. Cheaper on paper, but it deletes gate events, so #tk-gates loses transitions it publishes outward and the log stops being a uniform record.

options.label: Both, per tier
options.description: fix skips plan as a stage AND auto-passes G3; change keeps all stages with one human gate. The tier table decides each independently. Most expressive, most to specify.

options.label: The agent asks, once
